name: Frida Live Instrumentation
author: igwtech
description: Drops Ultimate-ASI-Loader (as dinput8.dll) + frida-gadget (as frida-gadget.asi) into the NC2 game directory. ASI loader correctly forwards dinput8 exports so the game starts normally; gadget binds 127.0.0.1:27042 in resume mode. Companion orchestrator at ceres-j/tools/frida_re hooks ws2_32!recvfrom/sendto and decrypts NC2 UDP datagrams live with the LFSR+CFB cipher.
